_comment: Fictional persona for SOH-221 stress data. No real people.
name: Lila Moreno
about_me: I'm Lila, a sophomore and lead organizer of WolvHacks, the campus hackathon. We're expecting 600 hackers in March. I need two more title sponsors and mentors from industry.
goals: Sign two title sponsors for WolvHacks

debriefs.text: Zoe Park, president of Women in Computing, is co-organizing WolvHacks with me. She said she'd handle mentor recruiting if I handle sponsors.
Met Lucia Ferraro, Ford recruiter, at the career fair. She said Ford sponsors two hackathons a year and budget decisions are made in December. I promised to send her our sponsorship packet.
Talked to Nate Okonkwo, a PM at Rivian working on charging software. He said Rivian might send mentors but not money.
Sam Delaney from engineering alumni relations runs mentor matching and offered to email alumni about mentoring at the hackathon.
Met Mei Tanaka, a data scientist at Domino's HQ, at a Women in Computing talk. She said Domino's sponsored a data challenge before and she'd ask her manager.
